body:
Human correction from Oct4 voice call, confirmed by PR416comment5983943412: all current review PRs need a focused merge-diff cleanup using their original implementation agents, with independent QA enforcing exclusion of unnecessary development artifacts/documentation. User also explicitly requests a draft sync PR in MChartier/agentic-development-workflow capturing today's actual rules. Audit: evidence contributes22006/26109 added lines across410/415/416/417/418/419 (84.3%); actual-base counts exclude stacked parents. Removed human-ready from410/415/416/417/418;419 label never applied. Prior receipts remain historical. No new product backlog admitted (zero unassigned admitted issues).

Focused merge-diff amendment (direct human instruction, 2026-10-04): Implementation and independent QA must inspect the complete merge diff against the actual base or pinned parent. Retain only product changes, proportionate maintained regression tests/baselines, required generated contracts/migrations, and genuinely maintained documentation needed for the outcome. Exclude one-off development/capture logs, build/export inventories, temporary readbacks, copied source, ad-hoc capture harnesses, screenshot archives and repetitive reports from the product merge diff. Do not game line counts or delete useful tests; explain retained exceptions. Before cleanup, preserve exact original evidence and every bound source/build/fixture/harness/manifest identity at an accessible retained location, verify reviewer access and rendered embedded Before/After images, then remove merge-diff churn. Existing immutable evidence commits may be retained on dedicated non-merged evidence refs in the same authorized repository, with explicit purpose/owner/retention record; no new service, credential, release or visibility change is authorized. No force-push or history erasure is needed for removal from the final merge diff. Never replace old receipt identities silently. Owner reports before/after diff composition; QA independently verifies full diff scope, retained evidence, behavior and final presentation and returns changes-required for avoidable churn. All existing pr-review-v3 evidence, receipt and human gates remain in force.

Correction order: original410 owner first because415/419 depend on its base; other original owners remain idle and retain branches. One implementation and one QA slot preserved. Existing evidence commits will be retained before removal from branch tips so matched captures and hashes remain accessible; archive refs are evidence retention only, never merge targets. No rewrite of unrelated branches. Canonical workflow sync is scoped separately to the user's requested process change; no additional product enrollment. Native ZBook verified connected/task-authorized; all affected owners currently completed/idle. Hard cutoff and existing finite cadence unchanged.
